declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this declaration in support of preliminary approval. Counsel negotiated at arm’s length over both class relief and attorneys’ fees; fees were not reserved until after agreement on class relief. The resulting settlement provides a $29 million fund for approximately 400,000 identified members, with payments made automatically rather than through a claims process. Brightline will separately pay up to $5 million in fees and expenses, subject to court approval. Brightline has not agreed to refrain from opposing the fee request, and any amount the Court does not award will go to the class, not Brightline. In my judgment, the settlement provides substantial, prompt relief in light of the unresolved certification question, the risks of trial, and the time required to reach a verdict. I ask the Court to grant preliminary approval and to evaluate the fee request independently.
